scope: Existing inter-world preparation and connecting-road presentation
source_findings: Preparation previously began only within 18 metres of a physical connector.
Nearest-exit changes could repeatedly cancel useful partial construction.
Arrival also requested all neighboring zone resources rather than one selected destination.
The Wychwood builder grouped many scenery and actor operations into 11 atomic stages.
Road geometry duplicated the manifest centerline and used largely identical bare covered bends.
retained_changes: Prepare one available destination after first control and checkpoint work settle; favor Wychwood during the opening.
Retain the selected preparation until another road is clearly approached; use connected objective destinations when selecting new work.
Yield construction around protected input, combat and aiming; allow movement and repay expensive atomic steps with quiet frames.
Background downloads share existing validated requests at lower priority; mount at most one background pack per frame and defer during protected activity.
Split Wychwood into 31 steps with all retained content and every required encounter actor ready before activation.
Derive connector geometry from the authoritative centerline; add supported arches, retaining edges, drainage, physical signs and regional roadside joinery.
Keep existing route locks, crossings, complete readiness, saves, quality presets and bounded residency.
limitations: No measured transition-time, frame-rate or memory improvement is claimed.
The 1.5 ms slice is cooperative; individual Godot publication operations are atomic and can exceed it.
Cold downloads, resource mounts and final activation can still require the existing loading presentation.
The previous candidate's runtime evidence is historical, not acceptance of changed routes or scheduling.
Rendered scenery, camera clearance, actual phone performance and user acceptance remain unverified.
manual_checks: Start in Greyfen, explore briefly, then walk into Wychwood and return immediately.
Approach a different unlocked exit, turn back, and confirm scenery and control remain intact.
Interrupt background preparation with dialogue, combat, pause and aiming, then resume travel.
Continue an earned save and change quality; confirm correct destination actors, quest states and Retry behavior.
Inspect every connecting road's signs, grounded details, clearance and lighting on desktop and phone.
